title: 第523章 酒楼飘香第522章 幽魂空间下
slug: 全球没功法的我自创功法
content_zh:
酒楼二层，一股霸道至极的焦香肉味，仿佛长了腿一般，从后厨的缝隙中疯狂钻出，瞬间席卷了整个空间。
那浓郁的油脂香气混合着秘制香料的辛烈，勾得人腹中馋虫疯狂蠕动。
不少雅间内的食客再也坐不住，纷纷推门而出，循着香味议论纷纷，原本安静的酒楼顿时喧闹起来。
雅间内，洛羽裳正百无聊赖地趴在桌上，数着桌纹发呆。
当这股香味钻入鼻尖，她那双灵动的眸子中，陡然爆发出一阵夺目亮光，仿佛饿狼见到了鲜肉。
“刷——”
一道残影闪过，她的身形瞬间窜出了雅间，速度快得连残影都未消散。
正欲出手拦截的叶不凡，手僵在半空，脸色大变，急喝道：“洛羽裳，你给我回来！”
……
后厨重地，热火朝天。
一只体型庞大的全羊被架在特制的烤炉之上，表皮已被烤得黄金剔透，油脂在高温下滋滋作响，顺着羊腿缓缓滑落，滴入炭火中激起一阵白烟，香气更是呈几何倍数爆发。
秦墨雪神情专注，正小心翼翼地往羊身上刷着秘制酱料。
她此刻眼中却透着一丝紧张与期待。
“啧啧，果然还是爱情伟大。”
叶念之双手抱胸，慵懒地靠在灶台旁，看着忙碌的秦墨雪，语气调侃道：“能让咱们秦家二小姐这厨艺，直接更上一层楼了。”
秦墨雪闻言，精致的脸颊上，瞬间升起两团嫣红，清澈见底的眸中满是羞意。
她有些微恼，跺了跺脚：“叶姨，您就别打趣我了。”
顿了顿，她似是想起什么，回头问道：“您……真的不去与林道见面吗？”
叶念之闻言，脸上的笑意淡了几分。
她直起身子，伸展了一下那成熟诱人的娇躯，胸前波涛汹涌，神情中闪过犹豫，最终摇了摇头：“还不是时候。”

“我去找了一些黑衣卫中的老朋友，问询过他父母之事，得到了一些信息。”
叶念之叹了口气，“等我将这些信息整理清楚后，再来邀请他一叙吧。”
她对林道有愧，本想着先为他打探父母的情报作为见面礼。
本以为黑衣卫那些朋友会推诿，毕竟林家之事早已隐秘封锁。
可没想到，他们竟直接将所有解密信息传递了过来。
然而，正是这些信息，让她看着直皱眉，心中隐隐不安。
【林霆夫妇曾在西北行省，沿着当年帝姬氏西征所行的路线前行，最终目的地未知。】
【林霆夫妇所在的研究所，曾长久驻扎在镇守之地，对那里进行过严密探查。疑似在搜索与古族血脉者相关的源头。】
【林霆夫妇遇难后，其所留魂灯，有过一段时间诡异的长明，疑似有概率还活着。】
这三条信息，如同迷雾中的线索，让叶念之不得不怀疑，有人在透着她的手布局，想一步步引导林道前往西北行省，前往那凶险万分的镇守之地。
这也是她拒绝现在与林道见面的主要原因。
“行了，你去忙你的吧。”
叶念之收敛心神，望向秦墨雪，嘴角轻笑道，“这里由我来接手，不然二楼雅间那群饿狼可就要闹起来了。”
说罢，她拍了拍手。
四名身穿红色服务装、身姿窈窕的靓丽女子从厨房外鱼贯而入，来到近前恭敬行礼：“念之大人，有什么吩咐？”
这些女子皆是修炼后天法的超凡者，也是她这一脉的核心成员，如今被安排在这酒楼做服务员与管理员。
这座酒楼产业，里里外外已彻底掌握在她手中，叶家主脉再想插手，已无可能。
“将这头黄金烤全羊，送至雅间01号。”
“是！”
content_en:
On the second floor of the restaurant, an extremely overbearing smell of burnt meat, as if it had grown legs, crazily emerged from the cracks in the kitchen and swept the entire space in an instant.
The rich aroma of oil mixed with the pungency of secret spices makes people's stomachs squirm crazily.
Many diners in the private room could no longer sit still and pushed the door open one after another. They talked about the smell, and the originally quiet restaurant suddenly became noisy.
In the private room, Luo Yushang was lying on the table boredly, counting the lines on the table in a daze.
When this fragrance penetrated the tip of her nose, a burst of dazzling light suddenly erupted in her smart eyes, as if a hungry wolf had seen fresh meat.
"Brush——"
An afterimage flashed by, and her figure instantly rushed out of the room, so fast that even the afterimage did not dissipate.
Ye Bufan, who was about to intercept, froze his hand in mid-air, his face changed drastically, and he shouted urgently: "Luo Yushang, come back here!"
…
The back kitchen area is in full swing.
A huge whole lamb was placed on a special oven, and the skin had been roasted until it was golden and translucent. The fat sizzled under the high temperature, slowly slid down the lamb leg, dropped into the charcoal fire, stirred up a burst of white smoke, and the aroma exploded exponentially.
Qin Moxue looked attentive and was carefully brushing the secret sauce on the sheep.
There was a trace of nervousness and expectation in her eyes at this moment.
"Tsk tsk, love is indeed great."
Ye Nianzhi crossed his arms and leaned lazily by the stove. Looking at Qin Moxue who was busy, he said jokingly: "It will take the cooking skills of our second young lady of the Qin family to a higher level."
When Qin Moxue heard this, two clusters of bright red instantly appeared on her delicate cheeks, and her clear eyes were full of shame.
She was slightly annoyed and stamped her feet: "Aunt Ye, please stop teasing me."
After a pause, she seemed to remember something, and turned around and asked, "Are you...really not going to meet Lindao?"
When Ye Nianzhi heard this, the smile on his face faded a bit.
She straightened up and stretched her mature and attractive body. Her chest was rippling. Hesitation flashed across her expression, and she finally shook her head: "It's not the time yet."
"I went to find some old friends in the Black Guards, asked about his parents, and got some information."
Ye Nianzhi sighed, "After I sort out this information, I'll invite him to talk."
She felt guilty for Lin Dao, and originally wanted to find out information about his parents for him as a meeting gift.
I thought that the friends in the black guard would pass the blame, after all, the Lin family's affairs had been secretly sealed.
Unexpectedly, they actually passed all the decrypted information directly.
However, it was this information that made her frown and feel uneasy.
[Lin Ting and his wife once traveled in the northwest province, following the route taken by Emperor Ji's Western Expedition, but the final destination is unknown. 】
[The research institute where Lin Ting and his wife are working has been stationed in the guarded area for a long time and has conducted rigorous inspections there. It is suspected that they are searching for sources related to people with ancient bloodline. 】
[After Lin Ting and his wife were killed, the soul lantern left behind by them was strangely bright for a period of time, and it was suspected that they might still be alive. 】
These three pieces of information, like clues in the fog, forced Ye Nianzhi to suspect that someone was using her hands to guide Lin Dao step by step to the northwest province and to the extremely dangerous place to be guarded.
This is also the main reason why she refuses to meet Lindao now.
"Okay, go and do your work."
Ye Nianzhi calmed down, looked at Qin Moxue, and said with a chuckle, "I will take over here, otherwise the group of hungry wolves in the private room on the second floor will cause trouble."
After saying that, she clapped her hands.
Four slim and beautiful women in red service attire filed in from outside the kitchen, came forward and saluted respectfully: "Lord Nianzhi, what are your orders?"
These women are all extraordinary people who practice acquired skills, and are also core members of her lineage. They are now assigned to work as waiters and managers in this restaurant.
This restaurantThe industry is completely in her hands inside and out, and it is impossible for the main lineage of the Ye family to interfere.
"Send this golden roasted whole lamb to No. 01 Yajian."
"Yes!"
